description: Fan out a single-router tool to many routers in parallel (up to `concurrency`), targeted by routerIds or tag. Destructive tools need two-step confirmation: call without `confirmationToken` to get a fleet token (needs MIKROMCP_CONFIRMATION_SECRET), then re-call with it. Writes snapshot+journal each router for rollback. Returns per-router results with succeeded/failed counts.

confirmationToken.description: Fleet confirmation token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Required to fan out a destructive tool.

params.description: Params to pass to the tool (omit routerId — injected per router)

routerIds.description: Explicit list of router IDs to target

tags.description: Target all routers with ALL of these tags (mutually exclusive with routerIds)

toolName.description: Name of the tool to fan out (must be a single-router tool)

name: bulk_execute
title: Bulk Execute
